title: refactor: delegate SDK text helpers to chat
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes `text()` and `textStream()` through the canonical chat request and SSE paths
- Keeps simple prompt/message adaptation and option mapping explicit
- Preserves private/JSON mode, empty-response, cancellation, and one-request behavior
- Adds exact body and streaming parity tests

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck` (`packages/sdk`)
- `npm run test -- --run src/client.test.ts` (21 passed)
- `npx biome check --write src/client.ts src/types.ts src/client.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: One chat path to rule
gist.blurb: The SDK's text helpers found the main trail home. `text()` and `textStream()` now travel through the same chat and SSE paths, with fewer parallel tunnels to maintain.
gist.summary: Refactored the SDK's `text()` and `textStream()` helpers to delegate to the canonical chat request and SSE streaming paths while preserving prompt adaptation, option mapping, private/JSON mode, cancellation, empty responses, and single-request behavior.
gist.impact: SDK users get text and streaming helpers with verified request-body and stream behavior matching the canonical chat API, so the simple interface stays consistent with the main one.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny trail guide in a cozy code garden, merging two small paths labeled text and textStream into one well-lit path leading to a retro chat terminal. The monitor robot watches the unified SSE stream with delight while code-plants and flowers grow beside the route, representing less duplicated client logic and consistent request behavior.
